comments.note: aria-label added at the base class level — all renderers inherit it automatically. No other issues observed in BaseGridRenderer::createItemsPerPageSelector().

comments.note: AC1 verified by file inspection: BaseGridRenderer::createItemsPerPageSelector() adds ->attr('aria-label', 'Items per page') via the HTMLTag fluent API. Bootstrap5Renderer calls parent::createItemsPerPageSelector() and only adds CSS classes — aria-label is not overwritten.
No other renderer overrides createItemsPerPageSelector(), so all renderers inherit the aria-label from BaseGridRenderer.

Minor coverage gap: no unit test explicitly asserts the aria-label attribute is present in the rendered output. A dedicated assertion in RendererPaginationTest would guard against accidental regression.
